_doc: Space encounters rolled during warp. Choice keys: cost (credits, x bribe_mult when bribe=true), requires {flag|min_credits|has_item|crew_size_min}, chance (0..1) + chance_mods {'flag:liar': 0.2, 'perk:silver_tongue': 0.15}, then success/fail or result -> {text, effects}. Effects: credits, credits_pct, hp, rep{}, bounty{}, clear_bounty, items{}, record{verb,target_faction,public}, recruit (id|'random'), skill_points, flag{}, mishap, air_debt, ai (ShipAI line key). Text tokens: {bounty} {credits} {air_debt} {bribe}.

list.title: GHOST SHIP
list.text: A derelict liner, the 'Quarterly Projection', drifts across your lane. Every window is dark except one, which spells out WE ARE CLOSED.

success.text: You find a stash of unclaimed severance packages and a working medkit. Nobody is left to claim them.

fail.text: Something in the dark bills you for the visit. In blood. You leave with a scrap of hull and a new fear.

success.text: One pod still hums. You thaw its occupant. They look at you, then at the Odd Duck, and decide you're the lesser evil.

fail.text: All pods read EMPTY - REPOSSESSED. You mark the wreck for the next fool.

result.text: QUACK plays a mournful kazoo solo as the ghost ship fades behind you.

list.title: DISTRESS SIGNAL
list.text: "MAYDAY... hull breach... please help... also, pre-order our debut album, out now on Lumen."

success.text: It's real. A smuggler named Pip is stuck in a leaking shuttle. They're grateful. Suspiciously grateful.

fail.text: It's a pirate ambush. They board, take a 'convenience fee', and leave you a one-star review.

result.text: The signal fades. You'll never know. Your crew will bring it up later, though.
Paragon thanks you for your civic engagement and charges you a 5-credit processing fee.

list.title: COMPLIANCE CHECKPOINT
list.text: A Paragon cruiser hails you: "Random inspection. You have been randomly selected by our completely random algorithm, which selected you specifically."

result.text: They scan you, fine you 10% of your savings for 'having savings', and wish you a compliant day.

success.text: The officer pockets it. "Have a safe flight, valued customer."

fail.text: "Attempted bribery of a Compliance Officer is a premium offence." They keep the money anyway.

success.text: The Odd Duck coughs, wheezes and somehow outruns a military cruiser. QUACK is insufferable about it.

fail.text: They clip your engines with a 'warning shot' that was not a warning.

list.title: AD DRONE LATCHED
list.text: An Ad Drone magnetically clamps onto your hull. "Watch thirty seconds of content to unlock your vessel!"

result.text: You watch a man in a suit eat Protein Paste and weep with joy. You receive 15 credits and a faint craving.
The drone explodes mid-jingle. Lumen's legal department has been notified automatically.

success.text: You redirect its advertising budget to yourself. Capitalism works!

fail.text: The drone counter-hacks you and subscribes the Odd Duck to 40 newsletters.

list.title: BOUNTY HUNTER
list.text: A hunter-ship named 'Due Diligence' matches your velocity. "There's {bounty} credits on your head, friend. Nothing personal. It's in my KPIs."

result.text: The hunter accepts payment and emails you a receipt titled 'Your Freedom (Temporary)'.

success.text: The 'Due Diligence' limps away. You salvage its bounty board, which oddly lists you as 'paid'.

fail.text: You barely escape. The hunter leaves a sticky note on your hull: 'See you next quarter.'

choices.text: Claim you're your own evil twin

success.text: "Oh. Sorry. Wrong twin." The hunter leaves to harass your nonexistent sibling.

fail.text: "That's what the real one would say." Shots fired.

list.title: LUMEN EXCLUSIVE
list.text: A Lumen news-skiff pulls alongside. A reporter with nine cameras for a face asks for 'your side of the story'. Which story? Every story.

choices.text: Spin it. You're the hero here.

success.text: The segment airs. You're 'a misunderstood entrepreneur'. Paragon lowers your bounty to avoid bad press.

fail.text: They edit your interview into a crime documentary. It's a hit.

result.text: Lumen has never aired the truth before. Ratings explode. Your crew looks at you differently.
The headline reads: DRIFTER REFUSES TO DENY EVERYTHING.

list.title: FREE SAMPLE
list.text: A Gristle promo-pod offers a complimentary tube of NEW Protein Paste Lite(tm): 'Now with 12% less mystery!'

success.text: Surprisingly nutritious. You feel 12% less mysterious.

fail.text: It was the recalled batch. It contained a tooth. Not yours. Not human.

choices.text: Resell it to your crew at a markup

result.text: Your crew pays 20 credits. Some of them will remember this.
The pod plays a sad trombone and logs you as a 'low-value consumer'.

list.title: OVERDUE NOTICE
list.text: Halcyon Debt & Trust: "Our records show {air_debt} credits of unpaid breathing. Please remit, or we will be forced to repossess your lungs."

result.text: Debt cleared. Halcyon sends a 'We'll miss you' card. It's a threat.

success.text: You restructure the debt into a smaller debt with a bigger font. Halcyon accepts.

fail.text: They restructure your debt upward. With fees for restructuring.

result.text: Halcyon flags your account. A repossession drone has your scent now.

list.title: CRYO AUCTION
list.text: A Halcyon auction barge is selling 'pre-owned humans' in cryo. One pod's label reads: 'Barely used. Has opinions.'

result.text: You buy a person to set them free. Halcyon calls it 'a great deal'. Your new crewmate calls it 'complicated'.

choices.text: Steal the pod during the auction

success.text: You swap the pod with a crate of Protein Paste. Nobody notices for hours.

fail.text: Alarms. You escape empty-handed and very much on camera.

result.text: The auctioneer shouts 'SOLD!' behind you. To whom, you'll never know.
